# Part 2 — Academy video mapping updates

**Review date:** 20 November 2026 · **Roadmap state:** Part 2 remains partial · **Change scope:** One official, item-specific MMBM example and one independent OTE lesson supplement.

## Verified mapping

- [April 08, 2024 NQ Market Maker Buy Model Example](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vsIPazjfGQ) is published by The Inner Circle Trader's verified channel. The upload title names the exact model and the Nasdaq futures example.
- The video is mapped only to `market-maker-buy-model`. It is not reused as evidence for related liquidity, ICT 2022, or other Entry Model lessons.
- The registry records the exact video ID, official channel ID, verification date and fallback link. Embed availability and permission remain unchecked; the normal YouTube link remains available.

- [Optimal Trade Entry (OTE) - ICT Concepts](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1YRs4Z1lMws) is published by TTrades' verified YouTube channel as an **independent supplement**, not Official ICT. Its description identifies Fibonacci settings, OTE within ranges and a PD-array alignment segment; it also says the video does not cover the New York Killzone.
- This supplement is mapped only to the `ote` concept lesson, not to the separate `fvg-ote-confluence-model` Entry Model. Its futures relevance is general education listed by the publisher; it does not claim a futures-specific worked example or evidence of performance.
- The registry records the video ID and channel ID, date, direct fallback, source class and scope caveats. Embed availability and permission remain unchecked.

- [How to Use the Unicorn Model for Trading Success](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rXMVPUZPw4A) is a TTrades independent supplement, not Official ICT. The description defines the Unicorn entry pattern as Breaker Block plus Fair Value Gap and provides model and example segments. The source is mapped only to the `unicorn` Entry Model and is not performance evidence.
- The registry preserves the creator/channel identity, video ID, exact lesson mapping and direct fallback. Embed availability and permission remain unchecked.

- [Inversion Fair Value Gaps (IFVG) - ICT Concepts](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uDJI2AbyyCs) is an independent TTrades supplement. The title and description directly identify the IFVG concept; its examples and general futures education make it suitable for the `ifvg` concept lesson only. It is not mapped to the separate `ifvg-reversal-model` Entry Model and does not establish a strategy edge.
- The source class, verified channel and video IDs, scope note, direct fallback and embed-check status are recorded separately.

- [ICT Power Of 3 - AMD](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TCFvsZeYvV8) directly teaches accumulation, manipulation and distribution, with examples and an explicit futures education tag. It is mapped only to the `amd-po3` lesson as an independent TTrades supplement, not Official ICT.
- [Change In State Of Delivery [CISD] - Orderblock Formation - ICT Concepts](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHIK5oBRKiw) directly teaches CISD with chart examples and an entry framework; the creator also tags futures education. It is mapped only to `cisd` and kept distinct from MSS. Neither video makes this site a tested or endorsed strategy source.
- [Intro to Market Structure Shifts, Fair Value Gaps, and Displacement - ICT Concepts](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PePk1V0Q4QQ) is an independent TTrades supplement. Its description gives separate chapters for Market Structure (0:21), MSS (1:15), Displacement (1:50), and FVG (2:23). Those four concept pages each link directly to their own timestamped segment; none is reused as evidence for an Entry Model. The upload is general concept education, not a futures-specific worked test or performance evidence.

The MMBM upload is an example, not a complete MMBM rulebook, an independently verified definition, or evidence of strategy performance. The Academy's MMBM definition remains supplemental and convention-sensitive, and the page continues to disclose that no audited performance evidence is available.

## Coverage and remaining work

The strict generated registry now reports **14/82 lesson pages** and **3/8 Entry Models** with a verified exact-item video. The eight model pages are included within the 82 Academy pages and remain separately tracked for acceptance. The remaining 68 lesson pages and five Entry Model pages still need individually verified mappings. A channel page, search result, or adjacent topic is not counted as item coverage.

The mapping does not complete Part 2. Review direct-link availability and embed permission separately, keep the source and coverage current, and complete the full Academy's visual, mobile, keyboard and assistive-technology QA.
